name: taxpayer identification number
note: Jersey's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: Jersey resident individuals are issued a TIN and a social security number at birth, and people moving to Jersey get a TIN once registered with Revenue Jersey; the TIN is a 10-digit number (e.g. 100-100-1000). Read as given at birth, to residents. No check rule, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Jersey: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: Jersey resident individuals are issued with a TIN and social security number at birth. Individuals moving to Jersey are automatically issued with a TIN once they are successfully registered with Revenue Jersey. ... the 10-digit unique number which is used to identify taxpayers to Revenue Jersey.
